author: WilloftheFans
quote:
A beautiful, measured, perfectly-executed recreation of arguably the greatest game ever made, that manages to expertly walk the line between doing too little and doing too much, getting it just right all the way through.
Characters are fleshed out, the dungeons are tightened. The only minor gripe someone might have is that certain parts are now easier thanks to total camera control and a dedicated jump button, but certain parts have been made more difficult or switched up to compensate for that, so it's fine and didn't bother me.
This was an absolute joy to play and lose myself in all over again. I'd recommend this almost over any other game in the world, especially for those who never played it originally.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: WilloftheFans
quote:
Rockstar have finally done it, they've finally lost ALL SENSE of what GTA is supposed to be.
You can't steal any car you want from anywhere you want immediately. You cannot carry a full arsenal of weapons around with you at any time. You have to constantly manage and maintain a relationship you might not even want to be in. You have to play as a boring dude or a total PITA. You can't kill protesters or open fire in a nightclub, meaning there are now protected groups, a cardinal sin in GTA. 
You also have to constantly eat, sleep and work out if you don't want the game to become more of a chore to play.
Rockstar have lost the plot.
Through a combination of DEI hiring, losing 2/3 of the creative force behind the series' highest achievements, and a relentless push towards hyper realism that no one wanted, Grand Theft Auto has transformed into real life simulator.
I do all the things this game wants me to do in my real life already, I do not want to do them in Grand Theft Auto. If I did, I'd play the Sims.
You are actively punished for playing GTA the way that made the series such a success in the first place, being branded "irredeemable" and having to deal with permanent consequences if you decide to blow up a bunch of people or shoot up a police station. For this reason, you are NOT even allowed to replay missions!
It looks worse than it did in the trailer too.
Don't let the gaslighting stans fool you either. Context is key, and the only reason people are SO angry about all of the above is because Grand Theft Auto is supposed to be the ONE series where you can do anything you want in a largely consequence-free environment.
This buggy, glitchy, 30FPS mess might be tolerable under any other name, but under GTA it is an ABSOLUTE FAILURE.
